story:
Jango was a war-leader of the clan that Kelic cursed, and not a patient one. When the elders could not break the curse and children began to sicken, it was Jango who said aloud what the others would not: that a curse wound round a totem holds while the hand that wound it holds the totem, and that hands can be stopped. The elders would not do it. Jango found men who would, the clan's deserters, who had run from its wars and owed it something, and promised them their names back if they helped.

They carried Kelic north into Raumarik, to a stand of trees at the snowline, and Jango did the killing himself while Runil and the others held the cursed man's arms. Then he drew a map, because he was a careful man in his way, so that the clan would know where the body lay and could be sure it stayed there. It did not stay there. Kelic stood up, totem and all, and the curse went on, and the deserters began to die on the road home, one by one, as the curse went with the hands that had carried it.

Jango did not go home. He went south and west instead, into the far corner of Vanern, as far from the clan as the realm's wild ground goes, and kept the map. The ferrymen say he had followers once, the deserters who got that far, and that they came out at night to steal from the swamp's edges; they say too that he is alone now, and that the followers are in the bog. He still has the map. Danica wants it, because it shows the way to Kelic, and because she wants to know exactly what the clan's war-leader knew of the man he killed.

Arnkel the ferryman, who has seen him from the water, says Jango stands at the edge of the reeds most evenings, facing north, as Runil faces east, and that the swamp folk call the far south-west corner the deserters' end.
legend: Jango is a mystic epic target in the far south-west corner of Vanern Swamp, level 62. The quest text says to kill him and his followers at night; in this world he stands there alone, day or night, so it's a straight fight with a level 62 humanoid. He's a plain spawn, nothing special: no adds, no tricks, and he isn't CC-immune, so a mez or root works if you need a breather. Bring a group at the level of the epic and he goes down. You want the map he carries for Danica: it's the map to Kelic. He's a long walk from the clay yards and the island, so you rarely get adds from the rest of the swamp.

loremasterTopic.text: The clan's war-leader who led the deserters to kill Kelic at Raumarik's snowline. Kelic stood up. Jango fled to the far corner of Vanern with the map, and the [ferrymen] say his followers are in the bog.

bookPage: From the count of Arnkel the ferryman: there is a man in the south-west corner who faces north every evening. He came into the swamp with eleven others, years ago, ragged and in a hurry, and paid me in clan silver to take them across. I took them. Over the seasons I fished four of them out of the black water, and notched them, and the rest I suppose the bog took without telling me. He is alone now. He keeps a folded map inside his shirt. I asked him once what it showed. He said: a man who would not lie down.
